limits.species: The exact publisher species is Be with InChI=1S/Be, not Be2, Be ions or an equilibrium vapor mixture. One mole of the source species is one mole of Be atoms. No molecular factor of two applies.
limits.phases: The gas-only response supplies one fit for 2741.437–6000 K. A separate retained condensed-phase diagnostic contains one LIQUID fit and two SOLID fits. Those fits are not imported, relabelled, or bound to the neutral atomic GAS state.
limits.lower_temperature: No gas evaluation below the source minimum 2741.437 K is justified. The retained source limits do not themselves establish a boiling point, a gas stability boundary or a pressure-dependent phase boundary.
limits.isotopes: Existing Be isotope records and atomic-weight data retain separate scope. No isotope-specific gas properties or numeric isotope abundances are inferred from this elemental fit or its listed molecular weight.
limits.pressure: The Shomate equations contain no pressure variable. Applied pressure, arbitrary-pressure EOS and phase diagrams are not inferred. Separate source entropy reference-pressure labels belong to those original data only.
limits.mixtures: No Be/Be2 equilibrium fraction, dimer dissociation, ionisation fraction, charge-state mixture or molecular nuclear-spin population is calculated or assigned.
limits.cross_phase: Fit boundaries from separate phases and enthalpy reference offsets are retained as reported and are not a constructed phase-transition path or latent-heat calculation.
limits.uncertainty: Coefficient uncertainty and covariance are unreported. Printed-temperature cells, output rounding and numerical derivative residuals are source-format/software checks, not physical uncertainty.
limits.evidence: Independent transcription arithmetic against publisher values and positive samples within the fit do not establish experimental replication, new calorimetry, complete Beryllium thermophysics or element completion.
